recommendation: Keep this commit. It completes the applied FHIR-43106 correction across current authoritative Bundle sources. If future machine enforcement of the granular batch/transaction entry exceptions is desired, handle that as a separate FHIRPath design decision.
issue_request: FHIR-43106 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6. It asked to correct Bundle.entry.fullUrl wording so fullUrl is required unless the Bundle is a batch or transaction request or response and the entry is a create, a non-single-resource operation, or a search/history invocation or response/result.
initial_application: FHIR-31354 was applied in a026c2f242 with the confusing older exception text. FHIR-43106 was later applied in c3a11dc9db to the Bundle.entry.fullUrl ElementDefinition, but the Bundle notes and bdl-15 invariant still retained POST-only exception language.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists bundle=Bundle in the active resources section. Confluence minutes record the 2023-11-13 FHIR-I vote for FHIR-43106, and targeted Zulip searches found no direct FHIR-43106 or conflicting fullUrl/search discussion. The checked-in bundle.svg still contains generated-looking stale text, but the authoritative XML/narrative sources now carry the corrected rule.
reconciliation: Updated source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml to point to the Bundle.entry.fullUrl exception list instead of describing only request.method = POST. Updated source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml bdl-15 to enforce fullUrl for non-batch/non-transaction Bundles, removed the standalone POST exception, and removed the now-stale bdl-15 condition from Bundle.entry.request.method.
source_changes: source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml: replaced the stale POST-only transaction/batch fullUrl omission note with text referencing the create, operation, and search/history exceptions in Bundle.entry.fullUrl.

source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml: aligned bdl-15 human text and expression with the non-batch/non-transaction fullUrl requirement and removed bdl-15 from Bundle.entry.request.method conditions.
